title: Question on the page "menu"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[menu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html

Hi-  Would it be possible for us to have two sets of filters for our search results? That is, use two menus at the same time on different facets?
